title: AI Product Video Ad Pricing for Ecommerce: What to Expect
summary: AI product video ad prices run from about $15 a month in software to $100 to $200 per managed video. Compare accepted ads, revisions and product checks.
body_markdown:
AI product video ads for ecommerce range from software plans starting at about $15 a month to managed packages that cost thousands of dollars a month, depending on what you buy. The price depends less on the plan than on how many accepted finished ads you get, how many revisions you need and whether campaign management is included. Knowlify is our top pick when you want finished product ads made for you, from $5,000 a month, with a person checking every ad. Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared.


## Knowlify: our top pick for done-for-you product video ads


Knowlify is the best fit when an ecommerce brand wants finished product ads without paying someone to operate a tool. It makes about 25 finished ads a week, so a first batch can cover several products or several angles on a best seller, and that batch lands on day 5. Its three formats suit product work: AI UGC with AI presenters for routines and explanations, 3D and stylized character animation to show how a product works, and AI commercials for brand-level spots. A person checks every ad before delivery, so ask that the check include your labels, packaging and included items against your approved photos.


Pricing is a custom quote, so divide it by the ads delivered to get your cost per accepted ad. You can buy creative only if you have a media buyer, or add end-to-end Meta campaign management. For a store that wants proof before committing, the 90-day refund guarantee lets you cancel by email for a full refund if the ads have not made more than you paid ([terms on the site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ). That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. Our[video ad production page](https://knowlify.com/video-ad-production) covers the service.


Pick another option when you need only a handful of ads a month and have an editor on staff, since a self-serve plan costs less in cash. Also pick another option when the ad must show a real customer or a live product demonstration, because Knowlify does not supply real human creators.


## What do self-serve AI product video tools cost?


Self-serve tools sell credits, so read the plan carefully. As of October 2026,[Creatify's pricing page](https://creatify.ai/pricing) lists its Standard plan at $15 a month billed monthly or $12 billed annually, with 55 credits, and 11 fifteen-second avatar videos at 720p or 1K. Dividing $15 by 11 gives about $1.36 per video before retries, edits or review time.


[TopView's pricing page](https://www.topview.ai/pricing) lists its Plus plan at $36 a month billed annually ($432 a year), with 100 credits a month. It has no free plan, and unused credits do not roll over.


[MakeUGC's Starter plan](https://makeugc.ai/pricing) is $59 a month billed monthly or $29 billed yearly, with 500 credits. Its API documentation lists 100 credits per talking-actor generation, which works out to about $11.80 per generation billed monthly and $5.80 billed yearly. Those per-generation figures assume every generation is usable, so a rejected take raises the real cost.


[Arcads](https://help.arcads.ai/en/articles/17595066-how-does-arcads-pricing-work) does not publish dollar prices on its public pages. Its pricing help article lists monthly credit allowances starting at 8,000 on Starter, so compare credits per finished ad rather than credits alone.


## What do managed AI product ads cost?


Managed services price three ways: per video, flat monthly volume or a package with a monthly minimum. As of October 2026,[Creatify's Studio page](https://creatify.ai/studio) says its managed Studio is a creative team handling strategy, scripting and production, with a person reviewing every ad. Its comparison table places Studio at $100 to $200 per video.


[CreatStrat](https://creatstrat.com/) prices by ads per week: $299 a month for 5 ads a week (20 to 25 a month), $499 for 10 and $899 for 20, billed monthly with cancel anytime. Its formats include statics, carousels, footage mashups, AI video and AI UGC. The page does not describe a revision policy or say whether a person reviews each ad.


[EditClub](https://www.editclub.co/) lists Crew at $1,600 a month for about 60 videos with 72-hour delivery. Club costs $2,400 for about 90 videos and Partner costs $4,000 for about 180, both with 24 to 48 hour delivery. Every plan lists unlimited revisions, ownership of your videos and source files, and no commitment.


[Airpost's pricing page](https://www.airpost.ai/pricing) starts at $6,000 a month, including its platform, a dedicated AI video production team, a Slack channel and an editor for copy and voiceover. It says it delivers 10 to 100 or more video ads and uploads them into your Meta account. Contract length is not published.


[Admiral Media's AI UGC page](https://admiral.media/ai-ugc-agency/) prices batches by length: €10,000 for 20 ads up to 15 seconds, €16,000 for 40 up to 30 seconds and €29,000 for 80 up to 60 seconds. Campaign and budget management are agreed separately.

Higgsfield's pricing page did not show plan amounts in our check, so it is left out of the table.
